releases.title: Engine complete
releases.summary: Phases 0–15 of the engine ship in this tree: storage, WAL, MVCC, SQL, optimizer, protocol, JSON, full-text, vectors, hybrid plans, security, backup/PITR/export, and Raft HA.
highlights: One WAL, one MVCC, and one optimizer for SQL, JSON, vectors, full-text, and geo
AES-256-GCM envelope encryption on by default
Native NSQL v1 protocol with official Go, JS, and PHP drivers

changes.text: Clustered B+Tree storage, group-commit WAL, and fsync before commit is acknowledged.
Hybrid SELECT: filters, SEARCH (BM25), and NEAREST (ANN) in one physical plan with reciprocal rank fusion.
Native JSON columns (NSJB) with path extract and path indexes.
VECTOR<F32,N> with flat and HNSW indexes.
Inverted full-text index, BM25 ranking, and phrase queries.
WGS84 POINT, BOX, and LINESTRING types.
Envelope encryption, TLS 1.3 off loopback, password auth, and RBAC.
Three-voter Raft, quorum commits, and encrypted replication.
nextsql init/serve/migrate and nextsqld with --key-file off the data volume.
Official Go, Node/Bun/Deno, and PHP drivers. Keys never go in a URL.
